text: I am writing to request your support to designate an on-street accessible loading zone on Sackville Street, between Cole Street and Oak Street. The establishment of an accessible loading zone will provide unimpeded curbside access to TTC Wheel-Trans service for the residents at 260 Sackville Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible loading zone to be in effect at all times, on the west side of Sackville Street, between a point 17 metres north of Cole Street and a point 16 metres further north.
